Government support of up to 90% of hard-intervention cost (95% in North-East, J&K and hill areas) and full funding of soft interventions such as training, design and marketing

benefit_type: Grant support for common facility centres and cluster infrastructure

checks.basis: eligibility_rules: Applying through an SPV, industry association or federation

Common Facility Centres: up to 70% of eligible project cost as Government of India grant (90% for special-category states), on a maximum eligible project cost of ₹15 crore
Soft interventions such as training, testing and marketing support are funded within the cluster project
exclusions: Units outside a recognised cluster
Projects already funded under another central scheme for the same cost

checks.label_hi: SC/ST या महिला उद्यमी, आयु 18+, नई ग्रीनफ़ील्ड इकाई स्थापित कर रहे हैं

Repayment up to 7 years including an 18-month moratorium

Borrowers who have defaulted on bank loans

benefit_type: Free, lifetime-valid MSME registration — the gateway to every MSME scheme
